notablePrerequisites: Delina does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Declare Delina as an attacker, triggering its ability, targeting any creature.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Delina's trigger, with the copy targeting Deceiver Exarch.
Resolve the copy of Delina's trigger, creating at least one token copy of Deceiver Exarch.
When the Deceiver Exarch token(s) enter the battlefield, they trigger, untapping Strionic Resonator and up to one other applicable permanent for each remaining trigger.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Deceiver Exarch token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.
